events.Name: Bandit Ambush
events.Description: You are ambushed by a group of bandits on the road. How will you respond?

choices.choiceText: Fight the bandits head-on.
choices.outcome: You bravely fight off the bandits and save your supplies.

choices.choiceText: Try to negotiate with the bandits.
choices.outcome: You manage to convince the bandits to leave you alone.

choices.choiceText: Run away as fast as you can.
choices.outcome: You flee, but lose some of your supplies in the process.

choices.choiceText: Ignore the bandits and keep walking.
choices.outcome: The bandits rob you while you ignore them. You lose experience.

events.Name: Bandit Leader's Hideout
events.Description: After defeating the bandits, you discover their hideout. What will you do?

choices.choiceText: Raid the hideout and take the loot.
choices.outcome: You steal the bandits' treasure, but your reputation suffers.

choices.choiceText: Report the hideout to the authorities.
choices.outcome: The authorities reward you for your information.

choices.choiceText: Set the hideout on fire and leave.
choices.outcome: You destroy the hideout and ensure the bandits won't return.

choices.choiceText: Leave the hideout untouched.
choices.outcome: You mark the place in your memory and move on. Whatever is inside can wait for a better-armed day.

events.Name: Wounded Knight
events.Description: A wounded knight collapses at the gates of your camp, seeking aid.

choices.choiceText: Provide medical aid to the knight.
choices.outcome: The knight recovers and offers to repay your kindness.

choices.choiceText: Take his belongings and leave him to his fate.
choices.outcome: The knight dies from his wounds and you gain his equipment.

choices.choiceText: Escort the knight back to his kingdom.
choices.outcome: The knight's family rewards you for returning him safely.

choices.choiceText: Ignore him and continue your journey.
choices.outcome: The knight dies from his wounds and you gain nothing.

choiceForTheFollowUpEvent.choiceText: Remind them of your previous encounter with the knight.
choiceForTheFollowUpEvent.outcome: The knight's family rewards you handsomely for a quest.

events.Name: Royal Gratitude
events.Description: The knight's family is grateful for your help and offers you a quest.

choices.choiceText: Accept the quest to prove your worth.
choices.outcome: You complete the quest and gain the knight family's favor.

choices.choiceText: Politely decline the offer.
choices.outcome: The knight's family is disappointed but understanding.

choices.choiceText: Demand more payment upfront.
choices.outcome: The knight's family refuses and you lose their favor.

choices.choiceText: Leave without a word.
choices.outcome: The knight's family is insulted and you lose their favor.

events.Name: Lost Child
events.Description: A lost child wanders into your camp, seeking help to find their family.

choices.choiceText: Help the child find their family.
choices.outcome: You reunite the child with their family and gain their gratitude.

choices.choiceText: Use the child as a distraction for a robbery.
choices.outcome: You gain some loot but lose reputation with the villagers.

choices.choiceText: Ignore the child and continue your journey.
choices.outcome: The child wanders off and you gain nothing.

choices.choiceText: Take the child to the authorities.
choices.outcome: The authorities reward you for returning the child safely.

events.Name: Mysterious Stranger
events.Description: A mysterious stranger approaches you with an offer of power in exchange for a favor.

choices.choiceText: Accept the stranger's offer.
choices.outcome: You gain new powers but at what cost?

choices.choiceText: Refuse the stranger's offer.
choices.outcome: The stranger disappears without a trace.

choices.choiceText: Attack the stranger.
choices.outcome: The stranger reveals their true form and curses you.

choices.choiceText: Ask for more information before deciding.
choices.outcome: The stranger offers more details but the choice is still yours.

events.Name: Haunted Forest
events.Description: The villagers speak of a haunted forest where the dead walk at night. They ask for your help in putting the spirits to rest.

choices.choiceText: Perform a ritual to put the spirits to rest.
choices.outcome: The spirits are put to rest and the villagers are grateful.

choices.choiceText: Destroy the spirits with force.
choices.outcome: The spirits are destroyed but the villagers fear you.

choices.choiceText: Ignore the villagers' request.
choices.outcome: The spirits continue to haunt the forest.

choices.choiceText: Investigate the forest for more information.
choices.outcome: You discover the source of the haunting and put the spirits to rest.

events.Name: Cursed Artifact
events.Description: A villager brings you a cursed artifact that is causing trouble in the village. They ask for your help in destroying it.

choices.choiceText: Destroy the artifact with brute force.
choices.outcome: The artifact is destroyed and the village is safe.

choices.choiceText: Use the artifact to gain power.
choices.outcome: You gain power but the artifact's curse affects you.

choices.choiceText: Bury the artifact to contain its curse.
choices.outcome: The artifact is contained but the curse remains.

choices.choiceText: Study the artifact for more information.
choices.outcome: You learn the history of the artifact and how to destroy it.

events.Name: Dragon Attack
events.Description: A dragon attacks the village, threatening to destroy everything in its path. The villagers ask for your help in slaying the beast.

choices.choiceText: Confront the dragon head-on.
choices.outcome: You slay the dragon and save the village from destruction.

choices.choiceText: Negotiate with the dragon.
choices.outcome: The dragon agrees to leave the village in peace.

choices.choiceText: Flee and warn the villagers.
choices.outcome: The dragon destroys the village and you gain nothing.

choices.choiceText: Use the villagers as bait to lure the dragon away.
choices.outcome: The dragon is defeated but the villagers are angry with you.
